english.note: Use 發夢 as the all-purpose verb for dreaming in sleep, and also for casual unrealistic daydreaming.

exampleSentences.english: I had a dream last night that I won the Mark Six.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我琴晚發夢，夢見自己中咗六合彩。
